Buyers are defending this level.

item.description:
人工智能实验室破解公钥密码学的传言使比特币：本机密钥暴露成为焦点。

712 万个 BTC 现在存放在其公钥已在链上可见的地址上。

余额处于历史新高，自 2023 年底以来几乎不间断地与价格一起攀升。

Rumors of AI labs cracking public-key cryptography have put bitcoin:native key exposure in focus.

7.12M BTC now rests on addresses whose public keys are already visible on-chain.

The balance sits at a record high, climbing almost uninterrupted since late 2023 alongside price.

item.title: 上一次这样的看跌期权热潮是在 2022 年 6 月。 比特币价格接近 2 万美元，处于投降阶
item.description:
上一次这样的看跌期权热潮是在 2022 年 6 月。

比特币价格接近 2 万美元，处于投降阶段。五个月后，最终的低点出现在 17,000 美元以下。

当时极端的看跌情绪显示出巨大的压力，而低点仍需要时间。

The last rush into puts like this was June 2022.

Bitcoin was near $20K, in the middle of the capitulation. The final low came five months later, below $17K.

An extreme in bearishness showed heavy stress then, and the low still took time.

@anti_fragile

比特币：本土期权交易者极度悲观。

他们以 2022 年投降期间最后一次的速度冲入看跌期权。未平仓头寸持平，每次看涨期权的看跌期权数量为 2021 年以来的最高水平。

这种极端的读数很少见，反映出市场正在为下行做好准备。

bitcoin:native options traders are extremely bearish.

They have rushed into puts at a pace last seen during the 2022 capitulation. Open positions agree, with the most puts per call since 2021.

Readings this extreme are rare, and reflect a market bracing for downside.

item.description:
比特币：本地矿工正在关闭机器。

算力比去年的水平低 8%，这是自 2021 年中国禁令以来首次年度下降。

这种下降是政策迫使的；这是价格驱动的，哈希价格处于历史最低水平。

bitcoin:native miners are switching machines off.

The hash rate sits 8% below last year's level, the first annual decline since the 2021 China ban.

That drop was forced by policy; this one is price-driven, with hash price at an all-time low.

item.title: 短期持有者成本基础集群现已转变为阻力。 今天，$BTC 冲入该区块并被拒绝。 这些买家
item.description:
短期持有者成本基础集群现已转变为阻力。

今天，$BTC 冲入该区块并被拒绝。

这些买家已接近收支平衡，许多人倾向于出售。

收盘价高于 65,000 美元将表明需求可以吸收其抛售。

The short term holder cost basis cluster has now turned into resistance.

$BTC pushed up into this block today and was rejected.

These buyers are back near break-even, where many tend to sell.

A close above $65K would show that demand can absorb their selling.

@glassnode

bitcoin:native下的短期持有者集群未能持有。

随着价格跌破 6.2 万至 6.5 万美元区间，短期持有者开始亏本加大抛售力度。

一旦价格低于它们，像这样的成本基础集群通常会成为阻力。

The short-term holder cluster under bitcoin:native has failed to hold.

As price broke below the $62K–$65K block, short-term holders started ramping up their selling at a loss.

Cost basis clusters like this often become resistance once price is below them.

bitcoin:native ETF volume has dried up.

It is now below its median since launch, while outflows run near $260M per day.

The last stretch this quiet, in mid-2024, came before the run to $100K. Periods of apathy tend to be better times to accumulate than periods of hype.

item.title: 山寨币泡沫消失了。 9 月底，现货总交易量是比特币的 4 倍。今天，该比率低于夏季低点
item.description:
山寨币泡沫消失了。

9 月底，现货总交易量是比特币的 4 倍。今天，该比率低于夏季低点。

在避险市场中，资本往往会整合到比特币中：原生。

在风险市场中，这些资本会重新流入风险较高的资产。

The altcoin froth is gone.

In late September, total spot volume was 4x Bitcoin's. Today that ratio is below the summer lows.

In risk-off markets, capital tends to consolidate into bitcoin:native.

In risk-on markets, this capital moves back into riskier assets.
